info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Decisioning By Consumer Id-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve decisioning data associated with a specific consumer identified by their unique ID. Designed for applications that require access to decisioning insights, this endpoint serves as a critical resource for analytics, reporting, and personalized service delivery. Common consumers of this API include data analysts, marketing teams, and customer service platforms that utilize decisioning information to improve customer interactions. By providing comprehensive decisioning data, the API supports informed decision-making and enhances consumer engagement.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information of a specific consumer using their unique ID. The response provides essential consumer attributes, enabling you to understand the consumer's profile and status within the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the consumer with ID 'RES-100045'. It may include various filters or options that the client can specify to fine-tune the operation.
